subject: Intro + demo request — understanding fit and calendar
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily@marketly.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood — quick demo?

Hi Soojin,

We signed up for the self-serve tier last week and have started poking at the API — really nice docs. We're evaluating for production use and would love a 30-min runthrough to understand:

- Best practices for embeddings + retrieval at scale (we're a search-first product)
- Typical latency/throughput tradeoffs for 1–2M monthly requests
- Security options (VPC/private, audit logs) and how they map to Dedicated vs Hosted

A little context on our side: Marketly is a B2B marketplace (SaaS) — primary use is semantic search and recommendation. Current rough traffic profile: ~200k tokens/day, spiky during business hours (50 RPS peaks), team of 3 engineers. Target timeline: pilot in 6 weeks, production in 3 months.

Would you or someone on your team be available for a quick demo + Q/A this week? Afternoon PST works best for us.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Chen
Head of Product, Marketly
[attachment: marketly-sample-activity.csv (CSV, 18KB)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@marketly.io>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — quick demo?

Hi Emily — great to meet you and thanks for the context. Congrats on the self-serve start. A few quick clarifying questions so we tailor the session and have the right folks on the call: 

1) Primary integration: are you planning to use the REST API directly, our Python SDK, or embeddings-only pipelines?
2) Concurrency & payloads: you mentioned 50 RPS peaks — is that sustained for minutes or short bursts (seconds)? Typical prompt length / tokens per request?
3) Evaluation criteria: is the pilot focused on latency, cost/unit, or quality/regression control?
4) Data sensitivity: will you send customer PII or private content to the hosted API, or would you need Dedicated/Private from day-one?
5) Timeline constraints: is the 6-week pilot a hard deadline (procurement or customer commitment)?

I attached a short traffic-template.csv that helps map token volumes to concurrency — if you can fill a row or two that'd be super helpful. Also attached the Redwood demo checklist so you know what we'll cover.

Proposed 30-min slots (PST):
- Wed 9/30 2:00 PM - 2:30 PM PT
- Thu 10/1 3:30 PM - 4:00 PM PT
- Fri 10/2 11:00 AM - 11:30 AM PT

If none of these work, reply with 3 times that suit you and I'll coordinate. Once I have the answers above I may invite Ben (AE) for procurement/contract questions.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
[attachment: traffic-template.csv (CSV, 4KB)]
[attachment: redwood-demo-checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Emily Chen <emily@marketly.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — quick demo?

Hi Soojin — thanks, answered inline below.

1) Integration: we'll start with the REST API (Node backend) and likely add Python SDK for offline evals.
2) Concurrency: peaks are short bursts (1–3 minutes) during report runs and index refreshes; typical prompt size ~120 tokens; embedding size ~1536 dims.
3) Evaluation: pilot looks at both cost/unit and latency (sub-250ms p50 for search).
4) Data sensitivity: most content is public listings, some buyer contact info (we'd prefer not to ship PII). Likely want Dedicated for prod if procurement looks clean.
5) Timeline: 6 weeks is driven by a marketing launch — fairly tight but flexible if procurement slows.

I've filled the traffic template and attached it. Afternoon slots are preferred — Thu 3:30 PM PT would work best.

Thanks — Emily
[attachment: marketly-filled-traffic.csv (CSV, 6KB)]

On Tue, Sep 30, 2025 at 10:05 AM Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Emily — great to meet you and thanks for the context. Congrats on the self-serve start. A few quick clarifying questions so we tailor the session...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@marketly.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Interested in Redwood — quick demo?

Hi Emily — Ben here (AE). Thanks for the quick turnaround and for filling the traffic template — that was really helpful. I'm looping in to lock the demo and cover procurement/ Dedicated options. Confirming Thu 10/01 3:30 PM PT for a 30-min session with:

- Soojin (SDR / demo lead)
- Ben (AE, procurement / pricing)
- One engineer from Marketly (if available, to discuss SDK + integration)

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m: introductions and goals for the pilot
- 10m: demo — embeddings + search pattern and cost/latency knobs
- 10m: deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated), procurement timeline, next steps
- 5m: Q/A and immediate action items

If anything changes on your side and you need to move, happy to propose alternate slots: Fri 10/02 11:00 AM PT or Wed 10/07 9:30 AM PT.

Also: Emily, since you flagged PII, we'll cover data handling and Private deployment options briefly and send SOC2 artifacts post-call.

I'll send a calendar invite shortly. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
